hero.title: GST calculator
hero.subtitle: Add or remove GST with the correct CGST/SGST or IGST split for India supply.

intro: Enter an amount and rate. Choose exclusive or inclusive mode and within-state or interstate supply. Calculation runs in your browser.

tips.title: Exclusive amounts
tips.body: Use exclusive mode when GST appears as a separate invoice line.

tips.title: Inclusive amounts
tips.body: Use inclusive mode when the total already includes tax.

tips.title: Supply type
tips.body: Same state as buyer uses CGST+SGST; different state uses IGST.
